text: The real session appears in ready within 5s of muse's TUI finishing launch (per the 2-14/2-23 siblings' live-confirmed pattern).
muse-bin PID bound to the real session via its .session.lock held flock fd.

The mock's first-attempt 429 produces a retry_scheduled task-status record, which drives working->error via the session_error classifier rule (SessionError.Phase=ErrorPhaseRetrying). This is ONE error entry for the whole retry window: the second retry_scheduled record (mock's second counted failure) does not produce a second transition, since the session is already in error.

The eventually-successful attempt's own terminal:"completed" clears the error via SessionError.ClearedByTurnBoundary (true because Phase==ErrorPhaseRetrying) -- error->ready, and this is the FINAL state for the recipe (no second turn is ever sent).
